3 عَاقَدْتُهُ عَلَى كَذَا , (Msb,) inf. n. مُعَاقَدَةٌ, (S, O, L,) I united with him in a contract, a compact, a covenant, an agreement, a league, a treaty, or an engagement, or I covenanted with him, respecting, or to do, such a thing. (S, * O, * L, * Msb.) ―
-b2- See also 1, former half, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
